title: Arcade controls card: a title, clear of the feed and the F1 hint
why: Critic on 47 (2 of 5): the F1 controls hint and a feed line showed through the edge of the card, and the card had no header. The card has a How to play title, sits above the feed, and the hint is not drawn under it.
now: The controls card at the arcade drop has a title and nothing behind it.
